basic_details.short_information: JK Bank Recruitment 2026 includes 1,033 Banking Associate vacancies in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and 20 Probationary Officer vacancies in Ladakh. content_sections.heading: JK Bank Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Reservation: The J&K Banking Associate notification references J&K UT reservation rules; the Ladakh PO notification references Ladakh UT reservation rules. Both show reservation percentages rather than a final category-wise vacancy allotment for each post. Category-wise vacancy counts have therefore not been inferred.

content_sections.heading: JK Bank Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for these posts must have completed graduation by the last date of registration. Domicile is post-specific: only J&K UT domiciles may apply for the Banking Associate notification, and only Ladakh UT domiciles may apply for the PO notification. Candidates must possess valid graduation marksheets or degree certificates by 26 November 2026 and supply their graduation percentage when registering. Domicile certificates issued by the competent authority will be required as specified in the notifications. Candidates claiming reservation must have the relevant valid certificate when registering.

rows.educational_qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a university recognised by the Government of India, or equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government/UGC.
Graduate in any discipline from a university recognised by the Government of India, or equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government/UGC.

content_sections.heading: JK Bank Age Limit
content_sections.text: The basic age requirement is calculated as of 01 January 2026 . Both notifications prescribe a minimum age of 20 and maximum age of 30 before applicable relaxations. J&K Banking Associate: SC/ST candidates: 5 years; eligible Socially and Educationally Backward Class candidates: 3 years; PwBD candidates: 10 years. Ex-servicemen provisions are subject to the conditions in the notification. Eligible candidates who completed apprenticeship with J&K Bank receive an additional one-year relaxation. Ladakh Probationary Officer: SC/ST and eligible SEBC (ALC) candidates: 5 years; PwBD candidates: 10 years. The notification also grants a one-time additional five-year age relaxation for 2025–2026 recruitment to both reserved and unreserved candidates, with total relaxations subject to an absolute maximum age of 56 years. Important: Relaxations are governed by the relevant UT notification, including cumulative-relaxation rules. Do not apply J&K Banking Associate concessions to the Ladakh PO vacancy or vice versa.

content_sections.heading: JK Bank Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fees differ between the two notifications. All fees below exclude GST; online transaction charges are additional. Payment is online through the application payment gateway. Candidates should retain the generated e-receipt and submitted application form.

content_sections.heading: JK Bank Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection processes are different for the two posts. For Banking Associates, minimum aggregate qualifying marks are stated as 40% for General and 35% for reserved-category candidates, subject to overall merit. For PO recruitment, shortlisted candidates advance through the notified examination and interview stages.

rows.selection_stages: IBPS-conducted online examination; subsequent eligibility and document verification. Provisional selection is based on the online examination score, subject to applicable rules.
Preliminary examination → Main examination → Interview, followed by eligibility and document verification. Final Mains/Interview score weighting: 80:20.

content_sections.heading: JK Bank Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded notifications prescribe the following subject-wise pattern for the Banking Associate online examination and PO preliminary examination. Negative marking: One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for an incorrect answer. No penalty applies to unanswered questions.

content_sections.text: The figures below are starting basic pay , not monthly in-hand salary. Other applicable perks are governed by the respective cadre rules. Posting conditions: Selected Banking Associates must serve at least five years within their initially allotted J&K zone; Ladakh Probationary Officers must serve at least five years within the Ladakh zone. The Banking Associate probation period is initially six months, while the PO probation period is two years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JK Bank Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can register online through the Careers section of the bank’s official website by 26 November 2026. Visit jkb.bank.in and open the Careers section. Select the correct detailed notification for J&K Banking Associate or Ladakh Probationary Officer . Choose Apply Online , complete new registration and note the registration number and password. Enter personal, educational, domicile and reservation-category information accurately. Upload the required photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration and supporting documents as directed in the application portal. Preview and verify all details before completing registration. Pay the applicable online fee, submit the form and save the application and payment receipt. Incorrect category or personal details may affect eligibility. Applicants should consult the post-specific PDF for complete upload sizes, document formats and declarations.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in J&K Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. has announced a total of 1053 vacancies for Banking Associates and Probationary Officers under advertisement numbers JKB/HR/Rectt/2026-493 & 494. Candidates can apply online through the official website.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive offers two positions: Banking Associate with 1033 vacancies and Probationary Officer with 20 vacancies. Both roles require candidates to possess a graduate degree from a recognized university along with required domicile credentials.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 7 November 2026 and concludes on 26 November 2026. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute technical glitches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for either the Banking Associate or Probationary Officer post must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Additional specific certificates like domicile documents are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for J&K Bank recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts requires candidates to be a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 30 years old. Upper age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by Document Verification for Banking Associates. For Probationary Officers, an additional Interview round is conducted after clearing the online examination and document check.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Banking Associates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600/- for SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM candidates applying for the Banking Associate position, while all other categories are required to pay Rs. 800/- through the online payment mode.

faq.question: Q8. Are candidates from other states eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, only domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and the Union Territory of Ladakh are eligible to apply for these positions as per the special conditions outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What salary can selected candidates expect?
faq.answer: Banking Associates receive a basic pay of Rs. 24,050/- in a structured scale, whereas Probationary Officers start with a basic pay of Rs. 48,480/- in their respective scale along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to visit the official website at https://jkb.bank.in/, navigate to the careers section, complete the registration, fill out the online application form, upload necessary documents, and pay the fee online.
